meta.name: XNA
meta.source_description: 我关注的文献方向是： 1. 核酸化学（nucleic acid chemistry） 重点包括 DNA/RNA/XNA/TNA、修饰核苷酸/核苷、寡核苷酸化学、aptamer、SELEX、核酸探针、核酸连接与扩增相关化学，以及与核酸底物直接相关的方法开发。 2. 核酸相关酶工程 重点关注以核酸、核苷酸或 XNA 为主要底物或主要功能对象的酶，例如： polymerase、DNA polymerase、RNA polymerase、reverse transcriptase、ligase、terminal transferase、nucleotidyltransferase、nuclease、ribozyme、deoxyribozyme，以及 XNA/TNA 相关酶。 如果文章的核心是这些酶的工程化、底物特异性改造或定向进化研究。

scope: Classify by the paper's core contribution, not by surface terms. Direct relevance requires central nucleic acid chemistry, nucleic-acid substrate methodology, XNA/TNA or modified nucleotide work, aptamer/SELEX/probe chemistry, ligation or amplification chemistry, or engineering of enzymes that act directly on nucleic acids or nucleotides. Indirect relevance is reserved for close methodological or mechanistic context that directly informs those core areas. If DNA, RNA, probes, CRISPR, sequencing, polymerases, nucleotides, or engineering appear only as tools, analytes, background biology, platform components, or future applicability, unrelated takes priority.

direct: The central contribution is nucleic acid chemistry or nucleic-acid substrate methodology, including XNA/TNA, modified nucleotides, aptamer/SELEX chemistry, nucleic acid probes, chemical probing, programmable nucleic acid systems, ligation chemistry, or amplification chemistry.
The central contribution is engineering, directed evolution, substrate-specificity redesign, or modified-substrate compatibility of a nucleic-acid-acting enzyme.
indirect: The paper characterizes a nucleic-acid-acting enzyme in a way that directly informs catalytic mechanism, fidelity, substrate recognition, inhibitor resistance, or future enzyme engineering.
The paper provides close nucleic-acid substrate, modified-nucleotide, probe, aptamer, sequencing, or chemical-probing context without introducing new nucleic acid chemistry or enzyme engineering.
The paper develops a selection, display, or screening platform explicitly demonstrated on nucleic-acid-acting enzymes, aptamers, XNA/TNA systems, or nucleic-acid substrate engineering.
unrelated: The core contribution is ordinary RNA biology, DNA replication/repair/recombination, chromatin, transcription/translation regulation, CRISPR/genome-editing use, sequencing/profiling use, or cellular mechanism rather than nucleic acid chemistry or enzyme engineering.

The core contribution is generic protein or peptide engineering, peptide/protein probes, imaging agents, activity-based probes, therapeutic conjugates, or enzymes that act on non-nucleic-acid substrates.

The core contribution is ML/software, drug-target prediction, genomic language modeling, metabolomics, proteomics, LC-MS, analytical chemistry, diagnostics, pathogen reduction, biomarkers, or assay performance.

The core contribution is a material, device, biosensor, aptasensor, nanostructure, nanopore, delivery system, hydrogel, semiconductor, diagnostic platform, or other platform where nucleic acids are only recognition elements, analytes, payloads, readouts, or validation tools.

Surface adjacency alone is unrelated: DNA, RNA, probe, aptamer, nucleotide, CRISPR, sequencing, polymerase, or engineering terms must be central to the chemical or nucleic-acid-enzyme contribution to count as relevant.
